content:
As the weekend rolls around, we're kicking things off with a continuing 25% discount on the AirPods Pro 3 and a sweet $100 price drop on the AirPods Max 2. However, the main highlight of today's 9to5Toys Lunch Break is the cheapest 13-inch M5 MacBook Air returning to $1,099 (down $200) in three colors via the official Apple Refurbished Store—but you'll need to act fast, as this configuration typically sells out quickly. We're also bringing you the newer MacBook Neo with up to $120 off, the Apple Watch Ultra 3 with Natural or Black Milanese Loop band down nearly $100 on Amazon, plus the latest 240W Braided Beats USB-C cable going for a low $18 with Prime shipping on Amazon (40% off). Be sure to check out the still-active 2026 Best Buy Back to School deals update for more details below.

Summer AirPods deals continue: Max 2 down $100, AirPods Pro 3 25% off, more from $99

  • AirPods Pro 3 $190 (regular price $249)
  • AirPods Max 2 $449 (regular price $549)
  • AirPods 4 $99 (regular price $129)
  • AirPods 4 (with ANC) $149 (regular price $179)
  • AirPods 4 (with ANC) $119 (regular $179 new) — Renewed Premium

Best Buy updates 2026 Back to School deals: TVs under $500, Bose down $130, Apple gear, Ninja kitchen appliances, more

Cheapest 13-inch M5 MacBook Air returns to $1,099 (down $200) in three colors via official Apple Refurbished Store

The official Apple Refurbished Store has always been a great place to save some cash, especially now that MacBook lineup retail prices have crept up. The cheapest configurations in both the Pro and M5 MacBook Air lineups have been repeatedly going in and out of stock, and this morning we spotted the most affordable 13-inch M5 MacBook Air in three colors ready to go for just $1,099—that's $200 below MSRP.

The official Apple Certified Refurbished Store is currently selling the 13-inch M5 MacBook Air with 16GB RAM and 512GB storage for $1,099 (shipping included). This deal was live at the time of writing and applies to Midnight, Starlight, and Sky Blue models.

These machines come with the following coverage:

  • Apple one-year limited warranty
  • Apple 14-day return policy
  • Eligibility for purchasing AppleCare
  • Resale after Apple's stringent refurbishment process

This is the cheapest configuration of the M5 MacBook Air, with a new unit priced at $1,299. Today's Apple Refurbished Store deal takes $200 off the new price, making it the best price we've found on the most entry-level model in the current generation lineup.

  • 13-inch M5 MacBook Air 16GB/512GB $1,099 (regular $1,299 new)
  • Midnight, Starlight, and Sky Blue

These are from the Apple Refurbished Store, so quality-wise they might be the nicest refurbished MacBook Airs in town, but how do they compare to current retail pricing on new units?

Amazon is currently charging near-full MSRP for this configuration, with the Silver model coming in slightly lower at $1,240. While we've seen this machine priced lower before, we haven't seen Amazon's new unit pricing drop below $1,149 since the price increase, and even that was a fleeting deal from about a month ago.

Apple Watch Ultra 3 with Natural or Black Milanese Loop band down nearly $100 on Amazon

If I do say so myself, two of the most handsome smartwatch combos on planet Earth are currently down nearly $100 on Amazon—the Apple Watch Ultra 3 paired with either the natural titanium Milanese Loop band or the black Milanese Loop band.

While the discount of $100 on the more affordable Ocean Band configuration has disappeared, Amazon is now selling the Apple Watch Ultra 3 with Natural or Black titanium case paired with the Milanese Loop band for $799.99 (shipping included).

These two configurations typically retail at $899 for the premium version with the gorgeous woven steel Milanese Loop band, but they're currently discounted by nearly $100 on Amazon:

  • Black Apple Watch Ultra 3 with Milanese Loop $800 (regular $899)
  • Natural Apple Watch Ultra 3 with Milanese Loop $800 (regular $899)

Apple is expected to launch its next-generation Ultra smartwatch next month, but the 'RAMageddon' (memory price hike wave) has already swept through the iPad and MacBook lineups, and the new Apple Watch could be the next victim. Existing models haven't been affected yet, but they're essentially mini computers on your wrist, and the Ultra 4/Series 12 could easily be the next targets of price increases.

Of course, we wouldn't blame anyone for waiting until just before the September event to see what Apple has in store, but in less than a month, these models could easily cost more than ever before.

The Series models face the same situation and are currently also $100 off on Amazon:

  • 42mm Apple Watch Series 11 $299 (regular $399)
  • 46mm Apple Watch Series 11 $329 (regular $429)

Grab the latest 240W Braided Beats USB-C cable at Amazon's all-time low of $18 with Prime shipping (40% off)

While the 240W black version is still available at its all-time low of $18 with Prime shipping, hurry and grab the 10-foot Beats Braided USB-C cable.

Amazon is currently selling the latest 10-foot Beats 240W USB-C Braided cable for $18.03, with free shipping for Prime members or on orders over $35.

These new 2026 models feature higher power delivery ratings and retail for $30, which honestly feels a bit steep even for a premium 10-foot USB-C cable. But at 40% off MSRP, I think anyone—whether for everyday carry or home collection—should pick up a few of these high-end, stylish cables.

Today's headline lowest price is on the Bolt Black model, but you can also find the Navy version for $19, the Surge Stone version at $20.85 after clipping the on-page coupon, and the red model for just over $24.

As mentioned earlier, this is the latest model, upgraded from the previous generation's 60W to 240W power output, with the cable length extended to 10 feet, while maintaining the same tangle-resistant fabric design—'More durable, more convenient. Elevate your charging experience and say goodbye to tangles, knots, and wear, featuring reinforced braided cable construction.'

Amazon restocks 46mm Apple Watch Series 11 cellular model down $100, starting from $299

Anker's latest 3-in-1 Qi2 25W foldable MagSafe charging stand returns to Prime Day all-time low (35% off)

After getting a chance to try it out earlier this year when it launched, Anker's 25W 3-in-1 Prime foldable MagSafe charger has become a must-have in my everyday carry, travel bag, and home charging setup. It's now available at nearly 35% off, with another chance to grab it at Amazon's lowest price.

Anker's official Amazon store is currently selling the latest 25W 3-in-1 Prime foldable MagSafe charger for $99.97 (shipping included).

Originally priced at $150, this 3-in-1 design features a MagSafe pad with up to 25W output, and both the Phantom Gray/Black and Radiant White models are at nearly 35% off MSRP.

This week's pricing matches what we mentioned previously, corresponding to Anker's summer sale and this year's Prime Day price levels.

Although this product is compact enough to fit in the palm of your hand for easy portability, it also has enough weight to sit stably on a desk or nightstand, making it equally suitable for your workstation or on-the-go use.

Today's accessories and charging deals:

  • Belkin's brand-new compact 100W USB-C MacBook GaN charger with 5-foot cable for just $25
  • Power all your desk devices with this SABRENT 252W 8-port charging station for just $60 (all-time low)
  • Baseus 20,000mAh 100W laptop power bank with dual built-in cables for just $33 (58% off)
  • Acer braided USB/Thunderbolt 4 Type-C cable supporting 240W charging, 8K, and more for just $16
  • Anker 140W 4-port MacBook charger with smart display today only $56
  • First deal: All-new Schlage Home Key Sense Pro smart lock with Ultra Wideband auto-unlock
  • KeySmart transparent 'Ghost' SmartCard Find My wallet tracker returns to Amazon low
  • Spigen compact MagSafe iPhone backpack/EDC pouch now $27
  • Anker 5-port Nano travel adapter 'works in over 200 countries' for just $20

Official Apple Refurbished Store MacBook Neo lowest prices, up to $120 off MSRP

In addition to the MacBook Air and M5 MacBook Pro lineup, Apple's more affordable new MacBook Neo has also seen price increases recently, but you can bypass those markups through the official Apple Certified Refurbished Store—the MacBook Neo starts from $689 on Amazon, but you can grab one with full Apple warranty from $599 through the best Apple refurbishment store around.

The official Apple Certified Refurbished Store offers all MacBook Neo configurations at the lowest prices we've found from reputable sellers, and they come with the same official Apple warranty and Apple's 'rigorous' refurbishment quality certification.

  • Apple Refurbished MacBook Neo 256GB $599 (regular $699 new)
  • Apple Refurbished MacBook Neo 512GB with Touch ID $679 (regular $799 new)

Although no special deals are visible on the Apple Refurbished Store product pages, all models are at least $100 below the new MSRP—the 512GB model with Touch ID keyboard is actually $120 below the new pricing and $20 below the old pricing.

Yes, they're refurbished, and yes, they only bring the pricing back to roughly the old MSRP levels, but we're talking about the lowest price on the most affordable MacBook in the current generation.

For some people, saving $100 to $120 isn't enough to justify buying refurbished, and that's understandable, but this is certainly no small amount, and we're talking about refurbished products direct from Apple with the most reliable quality.
